descFull: Pre-1.0. An omarchy-style desktop environment for macOS: tiling with a real Super key, dwindle layout, a themed status bar written for it, focus-follows-mouse, trackpad workspace swipes and a live workspace overview — ~157MB, six self-built Swift binaries, one repo. Built and tested on macOS 26 / Apple Silicon.

hnPosts.title: Show HN: Omacosy – Omarchy-style tiling desktop for macOS, no SIP
